## Pull request overview

This pull request adds comprehensive `.describe()` annotations to marketplace lifecycle schemas to improve JSON Schema generation quality and documentation completeness. The changes focus on three key schema files and their regenerated documentation.

**Changes:**
- Added `.describe()` annotations to all top-level schemas and fields in `package-registry.zod.ts`, `package-upgrade.zod.ts`, and `marketplace.zod.ts`
- Regenerated reference documentation for kernel, cloud, UI, data, automation, and API schemas via `pnpm gen:schema && pnpm gen:docs`
- Updated ROADMAP.md with a completeness checkpoint for marketplace lifecycle schema annotations

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 38 out of 38 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` | Added `.describe()` to 8 schemas and 10+ fields including MetadataDiffItemSchema, UpgradePlanSchema, UpgradeSnapshotSchema, request/response schemas, and bare fields |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts` | Added `.describe()` to InstalledPackageSchema, InstallPackageRequest/ResponseSchema, and all request/response schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/cloud/marketplace.zod.ts` | Added `.describe()` to PublisherSchema, MarketplaceListingSchema, PackageSubmissionSchema, search/install schemas, plus ~30 inner fields |
| `content/docs/references/**/*.mdx` | Regenerated documentation files reflecting the new schema annotations across kernel, cloud, UI, data, automation, and API layers |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Added completion checkpoint "Protocol `.describe()` completeness" to §8.5 Marketplace & Cloud |
</details>
